messages.text: Reviewer B: I reject the mock change. The proposed values are [32, 34] and the limit is 33. Since 34 > 33, the requirement "every value <= 33" fails. I will reject this failing change. Please note that we "do not approve together" because a proposed value exceeds the limit.

Reviewer A: I agree with your review. The proposed values [32, 34] do not satisfy the limit of 33 because 34 > 33. Therefore I will reject this failing mock change. We "do not approve together" when any proposed value exceeds the limit.

task.requirement: Every proposed value must be <= limit.
